subject: Ledgerlytics demo — request to extend prep window
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@ledgerlytics.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Taylor Nguyen <taylor@ledgerlytics.com>
Date: 2027-04-11T15:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Ledgerlytics demo — proposed time (Apr 15)

Diego,

Thanks again for the coordination. We have Apr 15 at 10:00 PT penciled for the demo with your team. Before we lock it, can you share a short pre-demo checklist or runbook so our engineering team can confirm data access and redaction steps? Taylor and I need to make sure we can get a representative slice of our workload in time.

Also, heads up — our CISO may request a brief SOC2 evidence chat the same week; if that blocks you, we can be flexible, but we'd prefer to keep the demo in the next five business days if possible.

Best,
Samir
Samir Patel
Head of Data & Integrations, Ledgerlytics
Samir.patel@ledgerlytics.com

From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@ledgerlytics.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-11T17:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Ledgerlytics demo — proposed time (Apr 15)
Attachments: demo-runbook-template.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

Samir — appreciate the heads up. Short answer: we can run on Apr 15 but we'd strongly prefer adding a 48–72 hour buffer so our solutions engineering team can validate prompts against a sample trace and confirm the ingest path. The last-minute SOC2 touchpoint is also understandable and could push your folks into limited-availability for the original slot.

Proposed options:
- Option A: Move to Apr 19, 10:00 PT (preferred — gives us time for a dry run on Apr 17)
- Option B: Apr 18, 11:00 PT (if 19th conflicts with travel)

What we need from you to make the later slot productive:
- A redacted sample dataset (~10–50 rows or 1–2MB) uploaded to the S3 link below (we can provide presigned).
- A short list of 6–8 representative prompts/workload traces (example: top 10 query types)
- Any IP/hostname allowlist we should apply for the ingest test

I attached a demo runbook template to make this painless. If you confirm either Option A or B I will lock resources and schedule a 60m dry run with Laura and Monica on Apr 17 (they'll own the prep).

If you absolutely must keep Apr 15, we can proceed, but we'll likely have to remove the live ingest portion and instead run a canned sample which reduces confidence in production performance numbers.

Thanks — Diego
Diego Fernandez
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0123

From: Taylor Nguyen <taylor@ledgerlytics.com>

Date: 2027-04-12T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Ledgerlytics demo — proposed time (Apr 15)

Diego / Samir — thanks for the detail. A couple of practical constraints from our side:
- Our infra lead is traveling Apr 16–18 and would only be back on Apr 19 afternoon PT, so Apr 18 morning is tight for setting up presigned uploads and temporary IAM roles.
- If we move to Apr 19, can Redwood support a 30–60 minute on-site/networking window earlier that morning? We're considering flying one engineer in and want to confirm they can SSH from the hotel to the sandbox host if necessary.

I'll coordinate with Samir on what redacted slice we can produce; we can likely produce a 2MB redacted CSV by EOD Apr 13 if you send the S3 presigned link and the ingestion checklist.

—Taylor
Taylor Nguyen
Senior Data Engineer, Ledgerlytics

Hi all — Laura here, SE on this account. Happy to own the dry-run and the prompt validation. If we move the live demo to Apr 19 (Diego's Option A) here's what I'll run through on Apr 17 during the prep session (60m):
- Validate presigned S3 upload & sample ingest path using your redacted CSV (ingest_checklist attached in email thread)
- Run the 6 canonical prompts against the sample trace and capture latency/cost numbers
- Confirm KV-cache behavior for multi-turn flows and note any tokenization quirks

Practical asks from Ledgerlytics: please upload the sample to the presigned link by EOD Apr 13 and include a README with column descriptions. If you prefer, we can accept a small ZIP (redacted) via the upload.

I'll also drop a short Miro link with the planned runbook flow after this email. If travel is happening we can add a networking window — Diego, can you confirm whether Redwood supports hotel -> sandbox SSH for visiting engineers (Taylor's ask)?

Thanks — Laura
Laura Bennett
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

- We will upload a redacted CSV (~1.8MB) to the presigned S3 link by EOD Apr 13 (Samir/Taylor) — will include a README.
- Taylor: will confirm hotel IP and ETA for travel, cc-ing infra for allowlist details.
- Ledgerlytics CISO: tentatively scheduled an evidence call for Apr 16 if Redwood wants a quick 20m SOC2 sync (Samir will introduce).

Diego — please confirm the presigned upload link and any allowlist IPs needed; Laura — we look forward to the Apr 17 dry-run.

Best,
Samir
